instruction: The native Altium schematic file `C:\Users\user\Desktop\oscillator_core.SchDoc` is the initial design. Add or update the user parameter `Classification` for each component, then save the modified native document as `C:\Users\user\Desktop\oscillator_classified.SchDoc`. Classification requirements: - `R42`, `R33`, `R39`, `R34`, `C1`, `C3`, and `L1` -> `Passive` - `Q16` -> `Transistor` - `V24` -> `Source` Do not delete any existing parameter. [Software] To use Altium Designer on Windows, run `D:\Program Files (x86)\Altium\AD17\DXP.EXE` (adjust if your install path differs).
